observation: FARC entered the municipality in the afternoon after paramilitaries crossed the river
Reported organization of a boat movement toward the town followed by FARC interception
Boat had returned by 06:30 with one paramilitary reported killed
Radio exchange included a deadline and an explicit challenge
FARC began crossing and entering Bellavista around midmorning
Civilians sheltered in the church and two adjacent buildings during afternoon fighting
Both sides agreed over radio to stop fighting until morning
Fighting resumed after renewed radio contact
Commander reportedly requested reinforcements by radio after losses
First projectile destroyed a home near the church with no reported fatalities
Second projectile fell without exploding at the health post a few minutes after the first
Third projectile exploded inside the church
Both sides communicated about ending fighting for the day
Commanders again agreed to suspend fighting until the next day
Witness recalled a helicopter firing near people gathered for humanitarian assistance
